    AI Overview
    The 2026 Masters champion will earn a record $4.5 million payout from a total purse of $22.5 million. This winner's share is the largest in tournament history and equals the top prize for The Players Championship. The runner-up takes home $2.43 million, with the top four finishers all earning over $1 million. 
    2026 Masters Top Payouts: 
    • 1st Place: $4,500,000
    • 2nd Place: $2,430,000
    • 3rd Place: $1,530,000
    • 4th Place: $1,080,000
    • 5th Place: $900,000 
    For context, this is a significant increase from 2025, when the winner earned $4.2 million. Additionally, professionals who miss the cut at the 2026 tournament receive $25,000.
